commands.command:
set -eu
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "SOURCE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "SENSOR_CONFIRM_USAGES"
grep -R -n 'SensorRemovalConfirmModal' apps/mobile/src --include='*.tsx' | head -50
echo "SENSOR_CSS_IMPORTS"
grep -R -n 'SensorSetupPage.css' apps/mobile/src --include='*.tsx' | head -20
echo 'LED_ISOLATED_CANONICAL_E2E'
set +e
LCL_E2E_PORT=5297 LCL_VISUAL_CONTRACT=1 pnpm exec playwright test -c apps/mobile/playwright.config.ts --grep='PLUGS_UI LED relay-state and off modes work end to end' --workers=1 --reporter=json >/tmp/shelly-ionic-190-isolated-led-e2e.json 2>/tmp/shelly-ionic-190-isolated-led.err
rc=$?
set -e
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib
s=pathlib.Path('/tmp/shelly-ionic-190-isolated-led-e2e.json').read_text(errors='replace')
try:
 j=json.loads(s[s.find('{'):]);print('STATS',j['stats'])
 for suite in j.get('suites',[]):
  for spec in suite.get('specs',[]):
   for t in spec.get('tests',[]):
    if t.get('status') not in ('expected','skipped'):
     print('FAIL',spec['title'],t['status'],str(t.get('results',[]))[:1200])
except Exception as e:print('ERROR_PARSING',str(e),s[-1200:])
PY
echo "EXIT=$rc"
uptime
git status --short
test "$rc" -eq 0
